page_title: EVE 1-0 BRE | Everton v Brentford 27/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' The foul by Ivan Toney (Brentford) was seen by Darren England who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90+5' A substitution has been made. Chermiti goes off and Michael Keane (Everton) comes on.
90+5' Everton take a short corner kick.
90+5' Chermiti (Everton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Everton are awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Kevin Schade (Brentford) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Jordan Pickford is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
90+2' Chermiti (Everton) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+2' OFF THE BAR! James Garner (Everton) produces a thunderbolt of a strike from distance, but his effort rattles the crossbar!
90+1' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
86' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) heads on.
84' Substitution. Kristoffer Ajer is replaced by Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford).
84' The linesman signals that Chermiti (Everton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
83' Darren England blows for a foul after Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
80' Brentford take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
79' Kevin Schade (Brentford) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Brentford.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amadou Onana (Everton) replaces Idrissa Gueye.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christian Norgaard leaves the pitch and Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) comes on.
77' Thomas Frank has decided to substitute Sergio Reguilon and he is replaced by Kevin Schade (Brentford).
77' What an amazing save by Jordan Pickford! Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot under the crossbar, but fails.
74' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
74' It's like he was asking for a caution. James Tarkowski (Everton) receives a yellow card.

73' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
71' The attendance for today's match is 39098.
70' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) makes a rough challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brentford.
68' Here is a change. Yoane Wissa is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford).
67' Substitution. Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) replaces Vitaly Janelt.
67' Dwight McNeil (Everton) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
65' It looks like Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) saw red with that tackle. Darren England won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
63' The linesman raises his flag. Chermiti (Everton) is adjudged offside.
62' Darren England sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
61' Wait! Referee Darren England has indicated he is going to review the Everton goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
60' 1 - 0 Goal! Idrissa Gueye (Everton) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top left corner. It's 1:0.
60' Dwight McNeil (Everton) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
57' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

57' Dwight McNeil (Everton) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Everton.
55' Darren England couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Yoane Wissa (Brentford) and blew his whistle.

54' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Dwight McNeil (Everton) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
51' Ivan Toney (Brentford) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Jordan Pickford anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
47' The referee blows his whistle as Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Darren England has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Ambitious effort from Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
43' Darren England shows a yellow card to Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) for his blatant foul.
43' Dwight McNeil (Everton) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
43' The resulting corner from Dwight McNeil (Everton) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
42' Jack Harrison (Everton) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
41' Darren England blows his whistle. Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) commits a foul after dangerous play.
39' Chermiti (Everton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
37' Chermiti (Everton) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
36' Ivan Toney (Brentford) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Darren England no option but to blow his whistle.
36' A nice individual effort by Ivan Toney (Brentford) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
35' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
34' James Garner (Everton) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Everton can continue in their attacking effort.
33' Ashley Young (Everton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Darren England blows for a foul.
32' Ben Godfrey (Everton) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
29' Everton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
28' A pass lands at the feet of Jack Harrison (Everton) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
27' Ben Godfrey (Everton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.
23' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
21' A lofted cross from Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
20' A dangerous looking corner kick from Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) is cleared to safety by the defence.

20' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brentford.
18' Brentford hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
14' Brentford failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' James Garner (Everton) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
10' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
9' James Garner (Everton) commits a rough challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for an infringement.

6' What a miss! Dwight McNeil (Everton) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
5' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
4' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
3' Ashley Young (Everton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Darren England saw the whole situation.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Everton will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Darren England.
